notes: Model: LDraw Official Model Repository file '8880-1.mpd' (Orion Pobursky), CC BY 2.0, https://library.ldraw.org/omr/sets/908. Not redistributed here; place it at samples/8880-1.mpd.

Gear ratios: Kinebrick's tests/sets/8880-super-car.test.ts (erik-larsen/kinebrick, CC BY-SA 4.0), used as an oracle: the engine turns 2.25, 1.5, 0.75 and 0.5 times per wheel turn in the four gears, neutral in the middle of the H gate.

The engine reaches the gearbox through a chain (3711 links) from the crank's 16T gear to 4019 on the gearbox input shaft, 16:16. Chains are phase 6, so the ratios are measured from that 4019, which turns 1:1 with the crank.

Model-file defect: the 8T gear 3647 at [-60,-14,-70] is on no axle, so 2nd (1.5) and 4th (0.5) never reach the wheels. Fix in the file: an Axle 8 (3707) centred at (-60,-14,0) along z. The checks keep the manual's four ratios and report these two as misses.
Ratios are read to the rear differential case with every differential locked, as when the car drives straight (wheel turns = case turns).
Parts are located by part number and world-box centre (LDU, LDraw axes: -Y is up).

mechanisms.title: 4-speed gearbox: two driving rings between clutch gears, neutral in the middle
mechanisms.why: Kinebrick 8880 test: 4-speed driving-ring box with ratios 2.25, 1.5, 0.75, 0.5 engine turns per wheel turn.

mechanisms.title: Four-wheel steering: steering wheel -> 24T gears -> pinions -> front and rear racks
mechanisms.why: 8880 steers all four wheels; one shaft carries the front and the rear pinions.
